                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Description                                                               | As a Customer, I want to book a tour so that I can participate in resort activities during my stay.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Preconditions                                                             | 1\. Customer has logged into the system with the Customer role. 2\. Tour information and tour schedules exist in the system. 3\. Selected tour schedule has available slots and the tour date is today or later.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Postconditions                                                            | 1\. Tour booking record is created with status Pending (VNPay) or Confirmed (Charge to Room). 2\. Available slots on the selected schedule are deducted by the number of participants. 3\. Total amount is calculated as Price per Person × Number of Participants. 4\. If Charge to Room: a FolioTransaction is created and GuestFolio totals are updated. 5\. If VNPay: a Payment record is created upon successful payment callback. 6\. A confirmation email with QR code is sent to the Customer. 7\. An in-app notification is created for the Customer.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Input Data                                                                | Schedule ID, Number of Participants, Payment Method (VNPay or Charge to Room), Room Booking ID (if Charge to Room), Primary Guest Name, Primary Guest Date of Birth, Primary Guest Gender, Primary Guest Passport/ID Number, Primary Guest Nationality, PDPD Consent checkbox                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Output Data                                                               | Tour booking record, booking status, total amount, payment redirect URL (if VNPay), confirmation email with QR code, in-app notification, success or error message                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Normal Sequence / Flow                                                    | 1\. Customer opens the Tour List page. 2\. System displays available tours with search, date filter, and sorting options (by price, rating, name, duration, schedule count). Only tours with upcoming schedules that have available slots are shown. Results are paginated (9 per page). 3\. Customer selects a tour to view details. 4\. System displays tour detail page with description, price, capacity, duration, location, gallery images, reviews, average rating, and a list of upcoming schedules showing date, start time, available slots, and guide name. 5\. Customer clicks the Book button on a specific schedule. 6\. System checks if the schedule has available slots. If no slots are available, system displays a "schedule is full" error and redirects to the tour detail page. 7\. System loads the booking form pre-populated with: tour name, image, location, duration, price per person, tour date, start time, available slots, and a list of the Customer's CheckedIn room bookings (for Charge to Room option). 8\. Customer fills in: Number of Participants, Payment Method, Primary Guest details (Name, Date of Birth, Gender, Passport/ID Number, Nationality), and checks the PDPD consent checkbox. If Charge to Room is selected, Customer also selects a room booking. 9\. Customer submits the booking form. 10\. System validates input: Participants is required (1–100); Payment Method is required; Primary Guest Name, Date of Birth, Gender, Passport/ID Number, and Nationality are all required; PDPD consent must be checked; Primary Guest must be at least 18 years old. 11\. System uses pessimistic locking (SERIALIZABLE transaction with UPDLOCK, ROWLOCK) to lock the schedule row and re-check available slots to prevent overbooking. 12\. System verifies that available slots are sufficient for the requested number of participants. 13\. System calculates Total Amount \= Price per Person × Participants. 14\. System deducts the number of participants from the schedule's available slots. 15\. System creates a TourBooking record with primary guest details and sets status to Pending (VNPay) or Confirmed (Charge to Room). 16\. If Charge to Room: system validates the selected room booking belongs to the Customer and has CheckedIn status; system updates the GuestFolio totals and creates a FolioTransaction record; system sends a confirmation email with QR code and creates an in-app notification; system redirects to My Tour Bookings page with a success message. 17\. If VNPay: system generates a VNPay payment URL and redirects the Customer to the VNPay payment gateway. |
| Normal Sequence / Flow – VNPay Payment Callback                          | 1\. After payment at VNPay gateway, Customer is redirected back to the VNPay return URL. 2\. System verifies the VNPay response. 3\. If payment is successful: system updates booking status from Pending to Confirmed; system creates a Payment record with VNPay transaction code; system sends a confirmation email with QR code and creates an in-app notification; system redirects to My Tour Bookings page with a success message. 4\. If payment fails: system updates booking status to Cancelled; system restores the available slots on the schedule; system redirects to My Tour Bookings page with an error message.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| Normal Sequence / Flow – View Booking History                            | 1\. Customer opens the My Tour Bookings page. 2\. System auto-cancels any pending bookings older than 1 minute (expired VNPay payment) and restores their available slots. 3\. System retrieves all tour bookings for the Customer, ordered by newest first, showing: tour name, image, location, date, time, participants, total amount, status, payment method, cancellation reason, and whether the Customer has reviewed the tour.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Normal Sequence / Flow – Cancel Tour Booking                             | 1\. Customer clicks the Cancel button on a tour booking. 2\. Customer optionally enters a cancellation reason and confirms. 3\. System validates the cancellation: booking must not already be Cancelled or Completed; for Confirmed bookings, the tour date must be more than 48 hours away. 4\. System restores the available slots on the schedule. 5\. If the booking was Charge to Room: system reverses the charge by reducing the GuestFolio totals and creating a Refund FolioTransaction. 6\. System updates booking status to Cancelled and records the cancellation reason. 7\. System displays a success message.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Alternative Sequence / Flow A1 – Validation fails                        | At step 10, if input data is invalid: 1\. System does not create the booking. 2\. System re-populates the form with tour and schedule information. 3\. System re-displays the booking form with validation error messages next to the corresponding fields. 4\. Customer corrects the data and submits again.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Alternative Sequence / Flow A2 – Schedule has no available slots         | At step 6 or step 12, if available slots are 0 or less than requested participants: 1\. System rejects the booking request. 2\. System displays an error message showing the remaining available slots. 3\. Customer may reduce the participant count or select another schedule.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| Alternative Sequence / Flow A3 – Primary Guest is under 18               | At step 10, if the Primary Guest's date of birth indicates they are under 18: 1\. System rejects the booking. 2\. System displays an error message: the primary guest must be at least 18 years old. 3\. Customer corrects the date of birth and submits again.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Alternative Sequence / Flow A4 – Invalid room booking for Charge to Room | At step 16, if the selected room booking does not belong to the Customer or is not in CheckedIn status: 1\. System rejects the booking. 2\. System displays an error message: invalid room booking or guest has not checked in. 3\. Customer selects another room booking or switches to VNPay.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Alternative Sequence / Flow A5 – Cancellation within 48 hours            | At step 3 of Cancel Tour Booking, if the tour date is within 48 hours: 1\. System rejects the cancellation. 2\. System displays an error message: cannot cancel within 48 hours of departure.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Exception Flow E1 – Database error during booking                        | If a database error occurs during the booking transaction: 1\. System rolls back the entire transaction (pessimistic locking ensures no partial data). 2\. System does not create the booking and does not deduct slots. 3\. System propagates the error to the default error handler.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Business Rules                                                            | BR-UC26-01: Only authenticated Customers can book tours. BR-UC26-02: Number of participants must be between 1 and 100\. BR-UC26-03: Number of participants must not exceed available slots on the selected schedule. BR-UC26-04: Pessimistic locking with SERIALIZABLE isolation is used to prevent concurrent overbooking. BR-UC26-05: Payment method must be either VNPay or Charge to Room. BR-UC26-06: Charge to Room requires a valid CheckedIn room booking belonging to the Customer. BR-UC26-07: Total amount is calculated as Price per Person × Number of Participants. BR-UC26-08: VNPay bookings are created with Pending status and auto-cancelled after 1 minute if unpaid. BR-UC26-09: Charge to Room bookings are immediately Confirmed and charges are added to the GuestFolio. BR-UC26-10: Primary guest must be at least 18 years old. BR-UC26-11: Customer must agree to PDPD (Personal Data Protection Decree) consent. BR-UC26-12: Confirmed bookings can only be cancelled if the tour date is more than 48 hours away. BR-UC26-13: Pending bookings can be cancelled at any time. BR-UC26-14: Upon cancellation, available slots are restored to the schedule. BR-UC26-15: Upon Charge to Room cancellation, folio charges are reversed with a Refund transaction. BR-UC26-16: A confirmation email with QR code and an in-app notification are sent after successful booking. BR-UC26-17: Form submissions are protected by anti-forgery token.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
