#### ***2.4.2*** **UC29 – Submit Reviews**

| Field                                                                       | Specification                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| --------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Use Case ID                                                                 | UC29                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Use Case Name                                                               | Submit Reviews                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Feature / Module                                                            | Review & Feedback                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Primary Actor                                                               | Customer                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| Secondary Actors                                                            | Business Manager                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Description                                                                 | As a Customer, I want to submit a rating and written review so that I can share my experience after using resort services (Room stay or Tour).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Preconditions                                                               | 1\. Customer has logged into the system with the Customer role. 2\. For Room review: Customer has a Booking with status CheckedOut. 3\. For Tour review: Customer has a TourBooking with status Completed. 4\. Customer has not already submitted a review for the same booking.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Postconditions                                                              | 1\. Review record is created with IsVisible \= true and HasBeenEdited \= false. 2\. Review is linked to the Customer, the service booking, and the Tour (if tour review). 3\. Review is immediately visible in the public review list. 4\. Customer is redirected to the public review list page with a success message.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| Input Data                                                                  | Star Rating (1–5), Comment (optional, max 2000 characters), Booking ID (for room review) or Tour Booking ID (for tour review)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Output Data                                                                 | Review record, success or error message                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Normal Sequence / Flow – Submit Review                                     | 1\. Customer navigates to the Submit Review page by clicking a review button from the My Bookings or My Tour Bookings page, passing either a Booking ID or Tour Booking ID. 2\. System checks eligibility: for Room review, the Booking must belong to the Customer and have CheckedOut status; for Tour review, the TourBooking must belong to the Customer and have Completed status. 3\. If eligible, system displays the review submission form with fields: Star Rating (1–5) and Comment (optional, max 2000 characters). 4\. Customer selects a star rating and optionally writes a comment. 5\. Customer submits the review form. 6\. System validates: Rating must be between 1 and 5; either BookingId or TourBookingId must be provided (not both simultaneously). 7\. System re-checks eligibility to ensure the service is still completed. 8\. System checks for duplicate review: if the Customer has already submitted a review for this booking, submission is rejected. 9\. For Tour reviews, system resolves the TourId from the TourBooking's Schedule. 10\. System creates a Review record with: UserId, BookingId or TourBookingId, TourId (if tour), Rating, Comment, IsVisible \= true, CreatedAt \= now, HasBeenEdited \= false. 11\. System saves the review to the database. 12\. System displays a success message. 13\. System redirects to the Public Review List page. |
| Normal Sequence / Flow – Edit Review                                       | 1\. Customer clicks the Edit Review button from the My Tour Bookings or My Bookings page, passing either a Booking ID or Tour Booking ID. 2\. System retrieves the existing review for the Customer and the specified booking. 3\. If the review has already been edited once (HasBeenEdited \= true), system returns null and the Customer is redirected with an error message. 4\. If the review has not been edited yet, system displays the edit form pre-populated with the current Rating and Comment. 5\. Customer modifies the Rating and/or Comment. 6\. Customer submits the edit form. 7\. System validates: Rating must be between 1 and 5\. 8\. System checks that the review has not already been edited (HasBeenEdited must be false). 9\. System updates the Rating and Comment, and sets HasBeenEdited \= true. 10\. System saves changes to the database. 11\. System displays a success message. 12\. System redirects to the Public Review List page.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Normal Sequence / Flow – View Public Reviews                               | 1\. Any user (including anonymous guests) opens the Public Review List page. 2\. System retrieves all reviews where IsVisible \= true, ordered by newest first. 3\. System supports optional filters: by star rating (1–5) and by service type (Room or Tour). 4\. Results are paginated (6 reviews per page). 5\. Each review displays: customer name, rating, comment, creation date, service type (Room or Tour), and service name (Room Category name or Tour name).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Normal Sequence / Flow – Manager: Manage Reviews                           | 1\. Business Manager opens the Review Management page. 2\. System retrieves all reviews (both visible and hidden), ordered by newest first. 3\. Business Manager can filter by star rating and service type. 4\. Business Manager can view review details.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Normal Sequence / Flow – Manager: Toggle Review Visibility                 | 1\. Business Manager clicks the Toggle Visibility button on a review. 2\. System toggles the review's IsVisible flag (true → false or false → true). 3\. System saves the change and displays a success message. 4\. System redirects back to the Review Management page.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Alternative Sequence / Flow A1 – Customer is not eligible to review        | At step 2 of Submit Review, if the service is not completed (Booking not CheckedOut or TourBooking not Completed): 1\. System does not allow review submission. 2\. System displays an error message: "You can only review after the service is completed, or you have already reviewed this service." 3\. System redirects to the Home page.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| Alternative Sequence / Flow A2 – Duplicate review                          | At step 8 of Submit Review, if the Customer has already submitted a review for this booking: 1\. System rejects the review submission. 2\. System displays an error message: "Review already submitted for this booking." 3\. Customer is returned to the review form with the error displayed.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Alternative Sequence / Flow A3 – Invalid rating or content                 | At step 6 of Submit Review or step 7 of Edit Review, if rating is null or outside 1–5: 1\. System rejects the review. 2\. System displays a validation error message. 3\. Customer corrects the data and submits again.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| Alternative Sequence / Flow A4 – Review already edited                     | At step 3 or step 8 of Edit Review, if HasBeenEdited\= true: 1\. System rejects the edit. 2\. System displays an error message: "This review has already been edited once and cannot be edited again." 3\. Customer is redirected to the Home page.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| Alternative Sequence / Flow A5 – Both BookingId and TourBookingId provided | At step 6 of Submit Review, if both IDs are provided simultaneously: 1\. System rejects the review. 2\. System displays an error: "Cannot provide both BookingId and TourBookingId."                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Exception Flow E1 – Database or system error                               | If a system error occurs during review submission or update: 1\. System does not save the review. 2\. The InvalidOperationException is caught by the controller and displayed as a ModelState error on the form.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Business Rules                                                              | BR-UC29-01: Only authenticated Customers can submit reviews. BR-UC29-02: Star rating must be between 1 and 5\. BR-UC29-03: Comment is optional but limited to 2000 characters. BR-UC29-04: Customer can only review services they have completed: Room bookings must have CheckedOut status; Tour bookings must have Completed status. BR-UC29-05: Customer can only submit one review per booking (duplicate check by UserId \+ BookingId or TourBookingId). BR-UC29-06: A review can only be edited once (HasBeenEdited flag). After the first edit, no further edits are allowed. BR-UC29-07: A review can only reference either a BookingId (Room) or a TourBookingId (Tour), not both simultaneously. BR-UC29-08: New reviews are immediately visible (IsVisible \= true) without requiring manager approval. BR-UC29-09: Business Manager can toggle review visibility (show/hide) at any time. BR-UC29-10: Only Business Manager can access the Review Management and Toggle Visibility actions. BR-UC29-11: Public review list is accessible by anyone (including anonymous users).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Related Use Cases                                                           | UC14 – View Reviews (Public List) UC26 – Book Tour UC48 – Toggle Review Visibility (Manager)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Related Components                                                          | Controller: ReviewController Service Interface: IReviewService Service Implementation: ReviewService ViewModels: SubmitReviewVM, ReviewListVM Entities / Tables: Reviews, Users, Bookings, TourBookings, Tours DbContext: ResortDbContext                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Priority                                                                    | Medium                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Frequency of Use                                                            | Medium                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Entities Affected                                                           | Reviews                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |

#### ***2.4.3 UC48 – Approve/Hide Review***

| Field                                              | Specification                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| -------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Use Case ID                                        | UC48                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Use Case Name                                      | Toggle Review Visibility                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Feature / Module                                   | Review & Feedback Management                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Primary Actor                                      | Business Manager                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Secondary Actors                                   | None                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Description                                        | As a Business Manager, I want to show or hide customer reviews so that only appropriate feedback is displayed on the public review page.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Preconditions                                      | 1\. Business Manager has logged into the system with the Business Manager role. 2\. At least one customer review exists in the system.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Postconditions                                     | 1\. The review's IsVisible flag is toggled (true → false or false → true). 2\. If hidden, the review no longer appears on the public review list. 3\. If shown, the review reappears on the public review list.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Input Data                                         | Review ID                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Output Data                                        | Updated review visibility status, success or error message                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| Normal Sequence / Flow – View All Reviews         | 1\. Business Manager opens the Review Management page. 2\. System retrieves all reviews (both visible and hidden) ordered by newest first, including: customer name, rating, comment, creation date, service type (Room or Tour), and service name (Room Category name or Tour name). 3\. System displays the review list. 4\. Business Manager can optionally filter by star rating (1–5) and by service type (Room or Tour).                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| Normal Sequence / Flow – View Review Details      | 1\. Business Manager clicks on a review to view details. 2\. System retrieves the review by ID including user, tour, and booking information. 3\. System displays the full review details: customer name, rating, comment, visibility status, creation date, service type, and service name.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Normal Sequence / Flow – Toggle Visibility        | 1\. Business Manager clicks the Toggle Visibility button on a review in the Management page. 2\. System retrieves the review by ID. 3\. System toggles the IsVisible flag: if currently true, sets to false (hide); if currently false, sets to true (show). 4\. System saves the change to the database. 5\. System displays a success message: "Visibility status updated." 6\. System redirects back to the Review Management page.                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Alternative Sequence / Flow A1 – Review not found | At step 2 of Toggle Visibility, if the review does not exist: 1\. System throws a not found error. 2\. System displays an error message. 3\. System redirects back to the Review Management page.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Exception Flow E1 – Database error                | If a database error occurs during the toggle operation: 1\. The review visibility remains unchanged. 2\. The exception is caught and the error message is displayed via TempData. 3\. System redirects back to the Review Management page.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| Business Rules                                     | BR-UC48-01: Only Business Manager can access the Review Management page and toggle review visibility. BR-UC48-02: Hidden reviews (IsVisible\= false) are not displayed on the public review list. BR-UC48-03: Visible reviews (IsVisible \= true) are displayed on the public review list. BR-UC48-04: The toggle action is a simple flip — there is no separate "Approve" or "Reject" workflow. The same button shows or hides the review. BR-UC48-05: There is no moderation note or moderation log — the action simply toggles the boolean flag. BR-UC48-06: Business Manager can toggle visibility back and forth unlimited times. |

## **3\. Functional Requirements**

### **3.1 Auth, Profiles & Master Data**

#### ***3.1.1*** **Authentication**

3.1.1.1 Account Registration Screen


* ***Function Description:** This screen allows new customers to register a member account on the PhucNguyen Resort system in order to utilize services such as room booking, tour booking, and personal schedule management. Users can sign up by manually filling out the registration form or by using the quick registration option via third-party Google account integration.*
* ***Use Case Mapping:** This feature implements **UC-21: Register Account**.*

| Field Name                                           | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| :--------------------------------------------------- | :----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Full Name** *(TxtFullName)*                | \- **Data Type:** String. \- **Format:** Accepts Vietnamese Unicode characters with accents and spaces. No special characters or numbers allowed. \- **Length:** Min 2 characters, Max 50 characters. \- **Initial Data:** Placeholder displays "Nguyễn Văn A". \- **Constraint:** Required.                                                   |
| **Email** *(TxtEmail)*                       | \- **Data Type:** String. \- **Format:** Must follow the standard global email format (example@domain.com). \- **Length:** Max 100 characters. \- **Initial Data:** Placeholder displays "example@email.com". \- **Constraint:** Required and must be Unique in the database.                                                                    |
| **Phone Number** *(TxtPhoneNumber)*          | \- **Data Type:** String. \- **Format:** Numeric characters only (0-9). Must start with a valid Vietnamese mobile prefix (e.g., 03, 05, 07, 08, 09). \- **Length:** Exactly 10 characters. \- **Initial Data:** Placeholder displays "0123 456 789". \- **Constraint:** Required.                                                                |
| **Password** *(TxtPassword)*                 | \- **Data Type:** String. \- **Format:** Masked characters displayed as bullet points (●●●●●●●●). Complexity requirements: must include at least 1 uppercase letter, 1 lowercase letter, 1 number, and 1 special character. \- **Length:** Min 8 characters, Max 32 characters. \- **Initial Data:** Empty. \- **Constraint:** Required. |
| **Confirm Password** *(TxtConfirmPassword)*  | \- **Data Type:** String. \- **Format:** Masked characters, same as the Password field. \- **Initial Data:** Empty. \- **Constraint:** Required. The input value must match the Password field exactly (100% match).                                                                                                                                   |
| **Terms of Service** *(ChbAgreeTerms)*       | \- **Data Type:** Boolean (Checkbox). \- **Format:** Single toggle checkbox. \- **Initial Data:** Default is Unchecked (False). \- **Constraint:** Must be checked (True) to enable the "Đăng Ký" (Register) button.                                                                                                                                |
| ***Field Group: Actions***                   |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **Register***(BtnRegister)*                 | \- **Component Type:** Button. \- **Description:** When clicked, the system triggers form validation for all input fields. If the data is valid, it creates a new user account, saves it to the database, and redirects the user to the Login/Verification page. If validation fails, appropriate error messages are displayed under the respective fields.        |
| **Continue with Google)***(BtnLoginGoogle)* | \- **Component Type:** Button (Third-party integration). \- **Description:** Redirects the user to the Google OAuth2 authentication interface for a quick and automated registration process.                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **Sign In** *(LnkLogin)*                     | \- **Component Type:** Hyperlink. \- **Description:** Located at the text line "Đã có tài khoản? Đăng nhập" (Already have an account? Sign In). Clicking this link redirects the user directly to the Login screen (/Account/Login).                                                                                                                       |

3.1.1.2 System Login Screen

![][image24]

* **Function Description:** This screen allows registered users (including customers and internal staff) to authenticate their credentials and securely access the system's private features. Users can log in using their email and password or authenticate quickly using their Google account via OAuth2 integration.
* **Use Case Mapping:** This feature implements **UC-01: Sign In (Login)**.

| Field Name                                          | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| :-------------------------------------------------- | :----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Email** *(TxtEmail)*                      | \- **Data Type:** String. \- **Format:** Must match standard global email format (username@email.com). \- **Length:** Max 100 characters. \- **Initial Data:** Placeholder displays "yourname@email.com". \- **Constraint:** Required.                                                                                         |
| **Password** *(TxtPassword)*                | \- **Data Type:** String. \- **Format:** Characters are masked by default as bullet points (●●●●●●●●). Includes an integrated password visibility toggle icon (Eye Icon) to show/hide plaintext password. \- **Length:** Min 8 characters, Max 32 characters. \- **Initial Data:** Empty. \- **Constraint:** Required. |
| **Remember me** *(ChbRememberMe)*           | \- **Data Type:** Boolean (Checkbox). \- **Format:** Single toggle checkbox. \- **Initial Data:** Default is Unchecked (False). \- **Constraint:** Optional. If checked, the system stores an encrypted cookie session to keep the user authenticated upon subsequent visits.                                                        |
| **Forgot Password** *(LnkForgotPassword)*   | \- **Component Type:** Hyperlink. \- **Description:** Clicking this link redirects the user to the "Forgot Password" or "Account Recovery" screen (/Account/ForgotPassword).                                                                                                                                                                     |
| ***Field Group: Actions***                  |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **Sign In** *(BtnLogin)*                   | \- **Component Type:** Button. \- **Description:** Triggers credential verification against the database. If correct, the system creates an active session and redirects the user to the appropriate landing dashboard based on their role (Customer, Tour Guide, Admin, etc.). If incorrect, a centralized error message is displayed.          |
| **Continue with Google***(BtnLoginGoogle)* | \- **Component Type:** Button (Third-party integration). \- **Description:** Initiates the Google OAuth2 authentication process. If the Google account is already linked or exists in the database, the user is successfully logged into the system.                                                                                             |
| **Sign Up Now** *(LnkRegister)*             | \- **Component Type:** Hyperlink. \- **Description:** Located at the text line "Don't have an account? Sign Up Now”. Clicking this redirects the user to the Registration screen (/Account/Register).                                                                                                                                           |

3.1.1.3 Forgot Password screen

![][image25]

* **Function Description:** This screen allows users who have forgotten their password to initiate the account recovery process. By entering their registered email address, the system will verify the identity and send a secure password reset link or token to the user's email inbox, ensuring secure account reclamation.
* **Use Case Mapping:** This feature implements **UC-19: Forgot Password (Account Recovery)**.

| Field Name                                                                     | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| :----------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Registered Email** *(TxtResetEmail)*                                 | \- **Data Type:** String. \- **Format:** Must match standard global email format (username@email.com). \- **Length:** Max 100 characters. \- **Initial Data:** Placeholder displays "yourname@email.com". \- **Constraint:** Required.                                                                                                                                                              |
| ***Field Group: Actions***                                             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| **Gửi Mã Khôi Phục (Send Recovery Code/Link)** *(BtnSendRecovery)* | \- **Component Type:** Button. \- **Description:** Triggers a server-side check to see if the entered email exists in the database. If it exists, the system generates a secure, time-sensitive password reset token and sends an automated link to the user's email inbox. A success notification is then displayed. If the email is invalid or does not exist, an appropriate validation/security message is shown. |
| **Sign In** *(LnkBackToLogin)*                                         | \- **Component Type:** Hyperlink. \- **Description:** Located at the text line "Back to Login”. Clicking this link cancels the recovery request and redirects the user directly back to the Login screen (/Account/Login).                                                                                                                                                                                           |

3.1.2.1 ID Card/Passport Photo Update Screen

| :------------------------ | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Số Hộ Chiếu / CCCD     | \- **Component Type:** Text Input Control. \- **Business Rule:** Ô nhập liệu hiển thị chuỗi ký tự sau khi được hệ thống giải mã nhị phân từ database. \- **Description:** Chuyển đổi nhanh qua lại giữa trang quản lý thông tin và các luồng lịch sử sử dụng dịch vụ tại resort.                |
| Vùng Tải Ảnh Giấy Tờ | \- **Component Type:** File Drag & Drop Upload Zone (IFormFile). \- **Constraint:** Hiển thị text hướng dẫn: *"Yêu cầu ảnh chụp rõ nét để thủ tục check-in diễn ra nhanh chóng hơn tại resort."* Chặn định dạng file không phải là ảnh.                                                                      |
| Khối Ảnh Hiện Tại     | \- **Component Type:** Image Preview Container. \- **Data Source:** model.PassportImage. \- **Description:** Hiển thị ảnh thu nhỏ (Thumbnail) của tài liệu hiện đang lưu trên server kèm nhãn thông báo phụ: *"Ảnh Hiện Tại \- Đã được xác minh"* giúp khách hàng yên tâm về trạng thái hồ sơ. |
| Nút Lưu Thông Tin      | \- **Component Type:** Submit Button (Màu vàng đất/nâu cam đồng bộ thương hiệu). \- **Action:** Kích hoạt phương thức HTTP POST gửi dữ liệu form và tệp tin ảnh về Profile/Update.                                                                                                                                 |
| Nút Hủy Bỏ Thay Đổi  | \- **Component Type:** Button (Viền nâu, nền trắng). \- **Action:** Thực hiện tải lại trang (Reload) hoặc điều hướng về trạng thái ban đầu để hủy các thông tin vừa chỉnh sửa trên form chưa lưu.                                                                                                            |
